description: Fresh prompts for the pre-registered confirmation v2 (2026-10-02). Written by an annotator who saw no generations or results, given only the two type definitions and the list of earlier prompts to avoid. Opening verbs balanced within type. M = asks what something means or why it matters; P = asks for a process, a scene or facts.
